title: Best Shopify Theme for Shoes & Bags: 5 Ready-Made Designs | UTD #Shorts
description:
A ready-made store for shoes, in four cards. Then a ready-made store for bags. Both are presets of Fuse, our theme in the official Shopify Theme Store.

• Clio — shoes
• Bond — bags
• Fuse — outdoor
• Node — fashion
• Fluid — beauty

Mega menu, color swatches, a size chart and quick view are just four of the 56 features in Fuse — plus plenty of sections to build with. Pick your design. We did the work, so you can focus on selling.

Try it free and pay only when you publish.

🔗 Fuse in the Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse
🔗 All UTD themes: https://themes.shopify.com/designers/utd2
🔗 Clio (shoes): https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse/presets/clio
🔗 Bond (bags): https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse/presets/bond
